articles.summary: The Buckle, Inc. (NYSE: BKE) announced today that net income for the fiscal quarter ended May 2, 2026 was $46.9 million, or $0.93 per share ($0.92 per share on a diluted basis). Net sales for the 13-week fiscal quarter ended May 2, 2026 increased 6.1 percent to $288.7 million from net sales of $272.1 million for the prior year 13-week fiscal quarter ended May 3, 2025. Comparable store net sales for the 13-week fiscal quarter ended May 2, 2026 increased 5.1 percent from comparable store net sales
